title: Visit
metaDescription: Plan a first visit to St John's Park in Sheffield, with Sunday times, what to expect, children and youth information, and practical travel details.

sections.eyebrow: First time at St John's Park
sections.title: First Visit
sections.body: Whether you are returning to church, exploring faith, or just looking for somewhere to begin, we want your first visit to feel straightforward and welcoming.

image.alt: People chatting and eating together after church

sections.title: Sundays at 10:45am
sections.body: We gather to worship Jesus, hear the Bible taught, pray, and share life together. Services are usually a little over an hour, and there is always time afterwards to meet people over refreshments.
points: St John's Park, Bernard Street, Sheffield, S2 5PU
Contemporary worship, prayer, and Bible teaching
Refreshments and conversation after the service

image.alt: People worshipping together on a Sunday morning

sections.title: What to Expect
sections.intro: You do not need to know the words, the format, or anyone in the room before you arrive.

cards.title: The service
cards.body: We sing together, read Scripture, hear Bible teaching that connects to everyday life, and spend time in prayer. On the first Sunday of the month we share Communion.

cards.title: Children and young people
cards.body: Children are very welcome. We regularly run age-appropriate activities during the service and through the week, and we work hard to help families feel relaxed and at home.

cards.title: Afterwards
cards.body: Please stay for refreshments and conversation. It is one of the easiest ways to get to know people and ask any questions you still have after the service.

sections.title: Children & Youth
sections.body: From younger children to teenagers, we want the next generation to know they are loved, known, and included in the life of the church.
points: Park Kids and Park Youth are part of the wider life of our church.
Midweek rhythms and Sunday gatherings both matter here.
If you want to ask about children or youth before visiting, we would be happy to help.

image.alt: Children and families enjoying activities around the churchyard

ctas.label: Get in touch about children and youth

sections.title: Location & Travel
sections.body: Hyde Park tram stop is right next to the church. We have limited on-site parking, with overflow parking nearby, and we are always happy to help if you need a little extra guidance before your first visit.
points: Hyde Park tram stop is beside the church
Use the contact page for maps, parking detail, and life-event enquiries

image.alt: The church building and grounds at St John's Park

sections.title: Contact Us
sections.body: If there is anything you want to ask before your first Sunday, from accessibility and children to what to wear, we would love to help.
